## What was created

`tests/org/apache/commons/csv/CSVParserAgentTest.java` — a self-contained JUnit 3.8 test class (`extends junit.framework.TestCase`, no `org.junit.*`, no external helpers), matching the JUnit version in `lib/` and compiling clean under `-source 8`.

### Coverage (all expectations drawn from `api/.../CSVParser.html` + the package summary)

| Area | Tests |
|---|---|
| **Constructor** | rejects null reader / null format with `IllegalArgumentException`; fresh parser reports `isClosed()==false`, `getRecordNumber()==0`, `getCurrentLineNumber()==0` |
| **`parse(String,…)`** | happy path (field values + count), multi-record, null string, null format |
| **`parse(File,…)`** | happy path via temp file, null file, null format, missing file → `IOException` |
| **`parse(URL,Charset,…)`** | happy path via `file:` URL, null url / charset / format |
| **`getRecords()`** | field values, trailing-newline doesn't add a record, no trailing newline, empty input → empty list, starts at current parse position (after `nextRecord()`), second call returns empty, ragged records with differing field counts |
| **`nextRecord()`** (package-private, reachable from same package & documented in the spec) | returns records then `null` at EOF, stays `null` on repeat |
| **`iterator()` / `Iterable`** | iterates every record, `hasNext()` false when exhausted + `next()` throws `NoSuchElementException`, for-each loop, closed parser → `hasNext()` false and `next()` throws `NoSuchElementException` (documented) |
| **Quoting** | quoted value containing the delimiter, doubled encapsulator, multi-line quoted value keeps one record while `getCurrentLineNumber()` outruns `getRecordNumber()` (the javadoc "ATTENTION" notes) |
| **Line/record numbers** | advance per physical line / per record; record number doesn't move past the last record |
| **`getHeaderMap()`** | `null` when no header configured |
| **`close()` / `isClosed()`** | state transition + idempotent close (Closeable contract) |
| **CSVFormat integration** | `CSVFormat.DEFAULT.parse(Reader)` shortcut, `CSVFormat.EXCEL`, `CSVFormat.RFC4180` |
